summary: Camping World Holdings filed an 8-K reporting that subsidiaries entered into an amended and restated mortgage credit facility with Manufacturers and Traders Trust Company. The $175.0 million facility includes $132.8 million funded at closing, refinancing prior debt, plus $42.2 million delayed draw commitments through 2031. Interest is SOFR plus 2.30% or base rate plus 1.30%. Maturity extends to August 2031. This is a routine refinancing, not a special situation, with no equity or structural change.
